Based on the documents, Giancarlo Fisichella's Jordan teammate was Takuma Sato. Sato is listed as a Jordan driver in the German (round 12), Hungarian (round 13), Canadian (round 8), and Brazilian (round 3) Grands Prix. The documents don't cover every 2002 race, so they can't fully confirm he was the teammate for the entire season, but nothing in them points to anyone else.

ANSWER: Takuma Sato
